description: Synthetic, hand-written (47 documents (36 are look-alike distractors), 14 questions). Compares single-search with multi-step answering on comparison, multi-hop, injection, restricted, cross-tenant and no-evidence questions. Offline runs use a deterministic citing model, so they measure evidence coverage and leaks, NOT answer quality. Not a statistically meaningful estimate of production quality.
